description_en: Deletes an agent account in the Cloud Customer Service System based on the instance ID and agent account name
description_zh: 根据实例ID及坐席账号名称，删除悉犀客服工作台坐席账号
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs delete-agent --instance-id ccc_xp_pre-cn-000 --account-name username@example.com --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteAgent

parameters.help_en: Unique ID for the customer request. Used for idempotency validation. You can generate it using UUID
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一ID。用于幂等校验，可以用UUID生成
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
AICCS instance ID.  
You can obtain it from Instance Management in the left-side navigation pane of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: Agent account name, which is the phone number or mailbox specified during account registration. It is unique within the instance
parameters.help_zh: 坐席账号名称，即账号注册时填写的手机或邮箱。实例内唯一
parameters.name: account_name

Code.description_en: Status code. A value of Success indicates that the request succeeded
Code.description_zh: 状态码。返回Success表示请求成功

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API invocation succeeded. Valid values:
true: Succeeded.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
调用接口是否成功。取值：
true：成功。
false：失败
